verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a REST API for syncs, models, sources, and destinations, authenticated with bearer API keys that can be scoped for AI tools. Syncs can be configured via API, Git Sync manages workspace resources programmatically, and an official MCP server lets agents manage syncs and create them from templates, while sync runs report per-run outcomes. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that sources and destinations can be created (not just read) via API or MCP, documentation that sync run and delivery history is exposed through the API or MCP rather than only the UI debugger, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven pipeline management.
